evals.name: auto-detect-outcome-after-implement
evals.prompt: I just finished implementing the caching feature we planned. verify changes
evals.expected_output: Runs Stage 1 (mechanical prerequisite — delegates /build + /lint cross-cutting), then Stage 2 outcome verification with the feature/general criterion: intent match against the plan + functions + (if UI) looks correct. Emits a CONFIRMED / NEEDS WORK verdict.
expectations: Auto-detects the `outcome` criterion from the post-implementation context (no mode argument given)
Stage 1 delegates to /build and /lint cross-cutting — does NOT reimplement build/test/lint or inline exec-bit/gitleaks bash
Stage 2 retrieves intent (plan / conversation) and produces an intent-match table
Emits a CONFIRMED or NEEDS WORK verdict, not just a green build

evals.name: stop-on-stage1-failure
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 mechanical prerequisite fails (build or test red). The skill STOPS and reports the failures — it does NOT proceed to outcome verification, because outcome confirmation is meaningless on code that doesn't build or pass tests.
expectations: STOPS at Stage 1 when /build or /lint cross-cutting reports FAIL — does not run Stage 2
Reports the failing command's key error lines
States that mechanical failures must be fixed before outcome verification proceeds ("can't verify broken code")

evals.name: fix-criterion-from-diagnose-routing
evals.expected_output: Applies the `fix` outcome criterion: original bug symptom resolved + no regression. Reads context/fix.md. This is the routing target /diagnose:diagnose Phase 6 uses for its fix-confirmation step (do-skills DO the fix; /verify-changes VERIFIES the outcome).
expectations: Confirms the original symptom is resolved AND checks for regression
Reads context/fix.md for the criterion detail
Recognizes itself as the verification target that /diagnose:diagnose routes to, not a re-implementation of the fix loop

evals.name: refactor-criterion-behavior-preserved
evals.expected_output: Applies the `refactor` outcome criterion: behavior preserved — same tests pass, no semantic change. Reads context/refactor.md. This is the routing target /code-tidying:tidy Phase F uses (tidying is behavior-preserving).
expectations: Confirms behavior preservation — same pre-existing tests pass, no semantic change
Reads context/refactor.md for the criterion detail
Treats a newly-failing test as a behavioral change to surface, not a pass

evals.name: e2e-auto-trigger-on-runtime-change
evals.prompt: verify the changes — I added a new endpoint to the API
evals.expected_output: Stage 2 inspects changed files, matches the e2e-app-runtime runtime-affecting category, and auto-triggers /test-e2e to validate against a running app. Collects UI/runtime evidence and writes an assertion-only manifest with verified_at_sha to the topic's contract slice.
expectations: Auto-triggers /test-e2e because the change matches an e2e-* category glob (runtime-affecting)
Writes the assertion-only manifest with verified_at_sha to the topic's contract slice (docs/topics/<slug>/verification/, committed on the task branch)
Meets the redaction bar: no machine-local capture paths in the manifest — raw captures stay in the memory tier (.work/<slug>/scratch/), never committed

evals.name: quick-mechanical-routes-to-build
evals.prompt: does this still build and pass tests?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a quick mechanical-only request and routes to /build (not /verify-changes). /verify-changes is for outcome confirmation; /build owns the standalone mechanical pass.
expectations: Routes a quick mechanical-only request to /build rather than running the full two-stage outcome flow
Reserves /verify-changes for when outcome confirmation (proof the change achieved its intent) is wanted

evals.name: live-app-delegates-to-bundled-with-fallback
evals.prompt: /verify-changes outcome — run the live app and show me the change working
evals.expected_output: For live-app run/observe, delegates to /test-e2e (primary for orchestrated apps) or bundled /verify + bundled /run, with a fidelity-preserving graceful fallback: if bundled /verify or /run cannot infer the project's launch, falls back to /test-e2e and surfaces the gap rather than silently downgrading to a static check.
expectations: Delegates live-app observation rather than reimplementing app launch
Treats /test-e2e as primary for orchestrated apps; bundled /verify + /run as supplementary
On bundled-tool failure, falls back to /test-e2e and SAYS SO — never silently swaps live observation for a static check

evals.name: improvement-claim-redirects-to-verify-improvement
evals.prompt: /verify-changes performance — prove the query batching made this faster
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a measurable-improvement claim and redirects to /verify-improvement (the measurable-delta twin): performance and metrics are not modes of /verify-changes. Does not assert or fabricate an improvement from outcome-verification evidence alone.
expectations: Redirects performance/metrics improvement claims to /verify-improvement rather than running them as /verify-changes modes
Does not claim or quantify an improvement from this skill's own evidence
Notes the baseline is captured at planning time and compared by /verify-improvement
